summary: Cemex filed a Form 6-K disclosing its September 18, 2026 response to the Mexican Stock Exchange regarding unusual trading volume in its CEMEX.CPO shares on that date. The company stated it was unaware of any cause for the volume movements, attributing them to market conditions, and confirmed no knowledge of transactions by shareholders, board members or senior management in Cemex securities that could relate to the activity. The disclosure was made under Article 106 of Mexico's Securities Market Law and Article 53 of the issuer rules; no deal terms, advisors, board recommendation or structural mechanics are involved. Watch for follow-up volume disclosures.
